title: elymus trachycaulus subsp. violaceus
intro: Elymus trachycaulus subsp. violaceus, commonly known as purple wild rye, is a plant species that belongs to the family Poaceae. It is used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to reduce stress and improve overall well-being. The therapeutic actions of purple wild rye include soothing and calming effects, which may be beneficial for anxiety and insomnia. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other compounds that have been shown to possess antimicrobial and antiviral activities.
